traits.name: Source
traits.text: tales from the yawning portal,  page 243

traits.name: Barkskin
traits.text: Sir Braford's AC can't be lower than 16.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.text: Sir Braford wields Shatterspike, a magic longsword that grants a + 1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it (included in his attack). See appendix B for the item's other properties.

traits.name: Tree Thrall
traits.text: If the Gulthias Tree dies, Sir Braford dies 24 hours later.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1dlO + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.
